questions.question: Foundation A woman of weight 600 N stands on both feet with total area 0.03 m². Calculate the pressure she exerts on the ground.
Foundation Explain why atmospheric pressure decreases with height above the Earth surface.

points.text: Atmospheric pressure is caused by the weight of air above a point. As height increases, there is less air above, so less weight of air, and therefore lower pressure.

questions.question: Higher Calculate the pressure at a depth of 5 m in sea water (density 1025 kg/m³, g = 9.8 N/kg).
Higher Explain, in terms of density and upthrust, why a solid steel block sinks in water but a steel ship floats.

points.text: The solid steel block is denser than water, so it cannot displace enough water to create an upthrust equal to its weight — it sinks. The steel ship has a hollow shape filled with air, making its overall density less than water. It displaces a large volume of water, creating an upthrust equal to its weight, so it floats.

questions.question: Foundation A drawing pin has a very small point. Explain why it is easy to push into a wall using the formula for pressure.

points.text: Pressure = force / area. The point of the drawing pin has a very small area, so the same force produces a very large pressure, easily piercing the wall. The large head has a large area, producing a small pressure on your thumb.

points.text: A solid block of steel has a density of about 7800 kg/m³, which is much greater than the density of water (1000 kg/m³). When placed in water, it displaces a volume of water equal to its own volume, but the weight of this displaced water (the upthrust) is less than the weight of the steel block.
